config.note: Fast screening pass (detection + lattice-fit only, no trace_path/skeletonize) run for all 5 variants on synthetic val (45 images) + all 22 real photos. Full graph-construction pass was NOT run for any variant beyond this: the fast pass already shows a decisive, consistent negative result on the #1-priority metric (no-dot false-positive rate) across all 5 variants, so the more expensive graph-level check was not justified by this experiment's time budget -- see docs/M4_2_CANONICALIZATION_EVALUATION.md.

A.description: grayscale + global Otsu threshold (== current production engine.image_io.preprocess() behavior, the baseline)

B.description: grayscale + CLAHE (local contrast) + global Otsu threshold

C.description: grayscale + illumination normalization (flat-field division) + global Otsu threshold

D.description: grayscale + CLAHE + adaptive (local) threshold + light morphological opening

E.description: grayscale + illumination normalization + adaptive (local) threshold + light morphological opening

decision: NO variant improved the no-dot false-positive rate (all 5 = 100%, 18/18, identical to baseline). Variants D and E additionally REGRESSED synthetic precision (0.63 and 0.90 vs baseline's 0.9995). No variant is recommended for integration.
